name: Two Wire Electric Supply Co
old_description: Family owned since 1975, we are a wholesale electrical supply distributor committed to providing the best products and customer service in the area.  We are a full line ABB (formerly GE) distributor of power distribution equipment. From light bulbs to switch gear we offer a wide range of products for the industrial, commercial, and residential contractor.
about:
Two Wire Electric Supply Co operates from Jackson, Mississippi. The company was founded in 1975 and has remained family-owned since its inception, building a presence in the region over nearly five decades.

As a wholesale electrical supply distributor, the company serves as a full-line ABB (formerly GE) distributor of power distribution equipment. Its product range spans from light bulbs to switchgear, covering a broad spectrum of electrical components for power distribution and control applications. The distributor maintains inventory across multiple product categories to serve immediate customer needs.

The distributor targets industrial, commercial, and residential contractors, supplying products for projects across those sectors. Its customer base includes contractors working on industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and residential construction, all of whom rely on the company for electrical materials ranging from basic lighting to complex switchgear assemblies.

The company states its commitment to providing the best products and customer service in the area, a principle that has guided its operations since 1975. Extended business hours from 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST on weekdays support contractor schedules and urgent project demands.
